preserves.note: v2 freeze files are untouched and remain the last frozen design until v3 is approved.

research_question: How do different approaches to generating investment views affect forecasting accuracy and portfolio decisions?

freeze_principle.across_approaches: The view-generation approach is the treatment; everything downstream of the views and all data, timing, cost and scoring protocol that can be shared is held fixed.
freeze_principle.within_ridge_compatible_systems: v2 principle retained exactly: only the feature set differs (AP1 vs AP3 family).

amendment_policy.rule: After any scored Stage-2 test result is viewed, no frozen parameter may change without incrementing the config version and rerunning every system on the same dates.
amendment_policy.bug_fix_exception: A true implementation bug may be fixed only if documented before rerun; all systems must be rerun and prior affected outputs invalidated.

AP1.definition: 8 macro surprise z-scores -> Ridge -> frozen BL

AP2A.definition: Agent Committee as built: Economist + Risk Manager -> CIO; 12M total-return views SPY/TLT + High/Medium/Low confidence; native 2-asset BL (60/40 prior, Omega = c*tau*Sigma, c 0.5/1/2), 40-80% SPY
AP2A.status: implemented; 272 saved monthly CIO outputs (gpt-4o), R-pre

AP2A-1M.definition: Same agents and roles; output schema re-specified to 1M expected excess returns for SPY/IEF/LQD; frozen BL with common Omega

AP2B.definition: JEV as built: p = P(SPY beats TLT over 12M), distribution over 5 tilt options (+3, +1.5, 0, -1.5, -3 points), confidence; edge = 60/40 BL-prior edge + confidence * sum(probs*points); 2-asset closed form clipped 40-80% SPY; p unused in allocation
AP2B.status: saved answers only (272 months); no prompt, recorder or model version

AP3.definition: AP1 columns + 2*N_ch causal-channel indicators -> identical Ridge -> frozen BL
AP3.status: proposed. CauseTrace (claireoh-duke/CauseTrace) supplies a static literature claims graph (Garg & Fetzer; 347,571 claims, 410,160 concepts) and bounded path retrieval with qwen3:4b explanations. The Hypothesis Agent, Testing Agent, monthly features and Ridge integration are not built

AP3-STD.cause_trace_definition: AP3-FLAT: channel routing by flat BGE-M3 similarity between shock and channel concepts (no path traversal), same number of routed links; Testing Agent, evidence source, thresholds, schema identical

AP3-PERM.permutation_rule: Joint permutation of the month index across all agent columns; no month may receive labels from within +/-3 months of itself

AP3-INT.role: Shock x Signal interaction model; separate pre-registered experiment with its own permutation placebo

AP3-MED.role: secondary control under B4 option M: AP1 + raw mediator changes, same column count, no routing or sign table

retired_v2_labels.C: retired; standard RAG becomes AP3-STD control
retired_v2_labels.D: retired; becomes AP3 with fixed schema

conventional_signals_paused.rule: Do not run, optimise, select, rank or expand. Preserve code, data, manifests and results unchanged as supplementary research.

V_controlled_view_quality.interface: One vector Q_t of 1M expected excess returns (decimal) for SPY, IEF, LQD per month-end decision, generated with information available at 20:00 ET

allocator.role: Secondary evidence; forecast performance is primary

covariance.inputs: Trailing realized asset excess returns available by decision time

omega.primary_test_rule: Diagonal forecast-error variance estimated from System A development-period OOS errors only, then frozen and shared by A/B/C/D during the historical test
omega.reason: Keep forecast-to-weight mapping comparable so System B/C/D do not receive a different uncertainty calibration merely because they are different systems.

allocator.optimizer: Same bounded optimizer for every system

omega_file.note: AP1 development errors; shared by all Track V systems; agent confidence only in a secondary run

benchmarks.forecast: Expanding historical mean excess-return forecast using only completed labels through t-2
benchmarks.portfolio_1: Historical-mean forecasts passed through the identical allocator and costs
benchmarks.portfolio_2: 45/35/20 monthly-rebalanced static allocation with the identical transaction-cost accounting

common_protocol: execution at next official close (native same-close replays re-scored)
pinned total-return data (TLT to be pinned and gate-5 checked)
N_native_systems.primary_statistic: Active CER = system CER minus CER of its own-universe neutral portfolio (45/35/20 or 60/40 prior), identical costs, block-bootstrap intervals

native_forecast_scores.AP2B: Brier (vs time-known base rate), log score, calibration, AUC of p against realised 12M SPY-vs-TLT event; 12M bootstrap blocks; tilt distribution RPS only with buckets frozen before scoring
native_forecast_scores.AP2A: 12M SPY/TLT view MSE vs time-known historical mean

universe.primary_market_data: Daily ex-dividend-adjusted total-return series, preferably Bloomberg total-return index; exact extracted files are hashed before first scored run.
universe.risk_free: 1-month US Treasury-bill cash return accrued over the exact holding period; exact source snapshot is hashed before first scored run.

decision_and_execution.decision_time: 20:00 America/New_York on the last trading day of each calendar month
decision_and_execution.execution: Official close of the first trading day after the decision date
decision_and_execution.holding_period: From that execution close to the official close of the first trading day after the next month-end decision
decision_and_execution.target: Asset total return over the holding period minus risk-free return accrued over the identical dates
decision_and_execution.training_label_rule: At decision month t, completed labels only through decision month t-2 may be used.

sample.burn_in_training_labels: Decision months 2015-02 through 2019-01 (48 completed labels available by the first scored forecast)
sample.prospective_start_rule: First month-end after the complete A/B/C/D signal-generation artifacts and this backtest config are frozen before the decision timestamp.
sample.v3_change: prospective_start_rule now references all v3 generators; LLM evidence tiers added

costs_and_turnover.definition: 5 bps charged to each dollar of traded notional

value: Every raw input file is SHA-256 hashed before the first scored Stage-2 run.
Every feature row has an available_at timestamp/date and must satisfy available_at <= decision_time.
Macro actuals are first prints; consensus is the pre-release Bloomberg median.
No latest-vintage ANFCI or GPR enters the primary A/B model.
ETF returns must be total returns with distributions aligned to ex-dates; adjusted-close reconstruction is unit-tested against a trusted total-return source.
All systems are scored on identical common dates.
No scored test output is generated until config and data hashes are written to the run log.
v3_additions: Per-call LLM logs (provider, exact model ID/snapshot, documented cutoff, parameters, prompt/context/response hashes, timestamps)
TLT total returns pinned and distribution-checked before Track N

macro_feature_construction.surprise: First-print actual minus Bloomberg median consensus
macro_feature_construction.zscore_window: Prior 12 releases only; current release excluded
macro_feature_construction.monthly_aggregation: Mean if multiple releases of the same indicator occur in one calendar month
macro_feature_construction.no_release: Missing before model scaling; after training-only scaling, missing standardized value is set to 0

forecast_model.model: Separate Ridge regression for each asset
forecast_model.feature_scaling: Mean/std fit only on finite observed feature values inside the current training fold

inner_cv.scheme: Expanding one-step-ahead CV inside the outer training sample

forecast_model.alpha_tie_rule: Choose the more strongly regularized candidate

reference_implementation.note: Canonical scorer adopted 2026-10-27; unchanged by this proposal

ap3_feature_schema_proposed.unit: one assessment per (decision month, channel) from information in (t-1 decision, t decision]
ap3_feature_schema_proposed.robustness_encoding: share of runs Supported / Contradicted (same column count)
forbidden: Shock x Signal interactions in primary
ap3_feature_schema_proposed.missing_month_rule: agent columns missing -> 0 after training-fold scaling; >5% missing months is a stop condition
ap3_feature_schema_proposed.applies_under: B4 options T and M; under option S the 8 agent columns are literature-selected interactions

primary_family.H1: AP3 vs AP1, gated: AP3-AP1 loss improvement must exceed the 95th percentile of 200 AP3-PERM placebo improvements
primary_family.H3: AP2A-1M vs AP1 (only if approved and frozen before any scoring)
primary_family.attribution_rule: Causal-reasoning claim requires H1 (Holm) + placebo gate + H2

retired_v2_family: C vs A (C becomes a control)
evaluation.loss_normalization: For each asset/month, divide squared forecast error by the expanding realized-return variance estimated using information available through t-2; average equally across SPY/IEF/LQD.

uncertainty.method: Paired circular moving-block bootstrap over months, resampling the three assets jointly

secondary: Track N active CER and native metrics
evaluation.secondary_multiplicity: No emphasised p-values; if emphasised, Holm within their own family
evaluation.event_regime_analysis: Predeclared diagnostic only, never used to select or tune a signal after test results are viewed.

evidence_tiers.P: Prospective: generated before the decision timestamp by frozen artifacts and pinned model; clean evidence
evidence_tiers.R_post: Retrospective replay for decisions after the pinned model's documented training cutoff; least-contaminated historical evidence; confirmatory language only if approved (B3)
evidence_tiers.R_pre: Retrospective replay for decisions on/before the documented cutoff; diagnostic only
evidence_tiers.rule: Never pooled; every LLM output tagged with exactly one tier; AP1 deterministic (historical window disclosed as partly inspected by the earlier MVP)

current_models.gpt-4o: documented cutoff October 2023 (confirm from provider page at pinning); R-post 2023-11..2026-08 if the snapshot can be pinned
current_models.claude-sonnet-5-5: causal-rag-mvp; cutoff after the window; R-pre
current_models.qwen3:4b: CauseTrace; released 2025; R-pre if called monthly; pinnable by Ollama digest; not called monthly under option M

leakage_protocol.point_in_time_inputs: available_at on every row/document; enforced in data-access layer; frozen hashed corpus with first-publication timestamps; edited/live/undated sources excluded
leakage_protocol.masked_replay: relative date markers, no calendar year; numeric context kept; unmasked subsample diagnostic; year-guess and sign-flip probes on the prompts actually used; masking is a mitigation, not a remedy
leakage_protocol.model_logging: provider, exact model ID and snapshot, documented cutoff, temperature/top_p/max tokens/seed, prompt/context/response SHA-256, UTC timestamp, run index; append-only caches
leakage_protocol.knowledge_graph: every edge with dated source; only edges published on/before t; simplest compliant graph uses literature before 2015-02; MVP graph not reused
leakage_protocol.testing_agent: only data with available_at <= decision_time; return labels through t-2 only; no realised holding-period returns, scoring outputs or sealed files; audited query log
leakage_protocol.revised_vintages: EPU/GPR revised vintages barred from Track V systems

historical_test.v2_readiness: Gate v4 readiness applied to the v2 A/B design and is superseded; v2 data gates remain valid evidence
opening_conditions: AP3/AP3-STD/AP3-PERM (and AP2A-1M if approved) generators built, tested, frozen and hashed
single scripted run scoring all systems
historical_test.recommendation: Keep the whole window sealed until every v3 generator is frozen (B6)

blockers.B1: Two-track design: Track V primary, Track N supplementary
blockers.B2: Agent Committee re-specified as AP2A-1M for Track V (or native-only)
blockers.B3: Evidence standard and LLM model choice (prospective-only vs R-post primary with a pinned pre-window-cutoff model)
blockers.B4: AP3 monthly evidence source (T text / M market mediators / S structure only) and schema; graph frozen from papers with year <= 2014; concept lists and sign table frozen before scoring
blockers.B5: Track N universes: native SPY/TLT (active CER) or harmonised SPY/IEF/LQD
blockers.B6: Keep historical window sealed until all v3 generators are frozen
blockers.B7: JEV saved answers diagnostic only; build a logged recorder for prospective runs or drop AP2B prospectively
blockers.B8: Use of mediator series overlapping paused B signals only inside AP3 and AP3-MED, pre-registered from the graph, no selection on results

robustness_only_not_primary: Alternative macro standardization using 24 prior releases

ap3_cause_trace_integration.static_knowledge_note: CauseTrace output is time-invariant for fixed concepts; monthly information must come from the Testing Agent

knowledge_graph.source: Garg & Fetzer, Causal Claims in Economics (arXiv:2501.06873) data release, macro claims
knowledge_graph.point_in_time_primary: claims with paper year <= 2014, frozen and hashed
knowledge_graph.year_field: annual publication-year metadata, not independently verified
knowledge_graph.licence: none published; hash and use locally, do not commit; confirm permitted use with authors

outputs: frozen concept lists: 8 shock concepts, channel mediator concepts, asset target concepts (exact node strings)
routing matrix shocks x channels from bounded graph paths
sign table (graph has no signs): LLM may draft, humans review, frozen and hashed

T_text.evidence: point-in-time news/Fed documents labelled per pathway (causal-rag-mvp style)

M_mediators.evidence: point-in-time mediator series named by pathways; Supported/Contradicted/Insufficient by direction vs frozen threshold
M_mediators.risk: overlap with paused B signals (B8); needs AP3-MED control

S_structure.evidence: none; literature-selected shock x shock interactions

testing_agent_options.recommendation: M primary; T prospective extension if a dated corpus is built

determinism: replace wall-clock path limits (default 5 s) with count-based limits; keep sorted successor order; log truncation
pin BGE-M3 revision (CPU encoding), FAISS index hash, claims-table hash, qwen3:4b Ollama digest
freeze exact concept node strings (near-duplicates are not merged)
unit test: identical features on two machines
ap3_cause_trace_integration.xai_metrics: CauseTrace citation-integrity/inspectability results are approach-specific diagnostics, never backtest metrics
